roles.name: Hub supervisor
roles.description: Keeps an eye on the whole hall and settles who does what.

roles.name: Information coordinator
roles.description: Sorts incoming reports and keeps the wall map current.

roles.name: Public information
roles.description: Writes the notices people read at the door.

roles.name: Reception
roles.description: Signs people in and points them to the right table.

roles.name: Needs and offers
roles.description: Pairs what neighbours ask for with what others can lend.

roles.name: Community space
roles.description: Sets up a quiet corner with seats, tea and blankets.

roles.name: Communications
roles.description: Runs the radio schedule and logs each call.

roles.name: Facility maintenance
roles.description: Checks the building, toilets and water each shift.

task_templates.text: Unlock the hall and check it is safe to enter.
Set out the sign-in sheet by the main door.
Ask arrivals whether anyone at home needs help.
Do a radio check on the agreed channel.
Start the decision log with the opening time.
